data.name: A Matter of Murder: Second Stab
data.detailed_description:
Why do the best country house parties always seem to end in murder? There’s nothing wrong with tea and polite conversation, of course — but a nice juicy mystery can certainly liven up a dull weekend. Luckily, one of your fellow guests has obliged by getting themselves murdered. Huzzah! Now it’s up to you to gather clues, interview suspects, and piece together the truth of what really happened tonight.

A Matter of Murder: Second Stab is a point-and-click puzzle game with roguelite elements, inspired by the golden age of detective fiction. In Case Mode, solve a series of progressively more complex mysteries, or put your little grey cells to work in Generative Mode, which remixes puzzle elements to create a fresh mystery every time you play. For detectives seeking a sterner test, Story Mode provides a three-act mystery with new mechanics, sharper twists, and a more intricate story.


Every case is a logic puzzle. Every bit of testimony matters. Every accusation has consequences. Whether you’re solving a pre-set case or untangling a procedurally generated web of lies, every investigation rewards keen observation and razor-sharp analysis. Can you uncover the truth before the killer slips the net?

  • Search four delightfully gothic crime scenes and grill an eccentric cast of colorful suspects.

  • Exercise your little grey cells with 20 pre-set challenges in Case Mode, each more fiendish than the last.

  • Enjoy a fresh case every time in Generative Mode, where puzzle elements are combined into brand-new mysteries.

  • Settle in for Story Mode, a longer, twistier case with new player mechanics and a plenty of “aha!” moments.

  • Mind the clock! Linger too long and you may find yourself suffering an unfortunate plot development.

  • Collect and equip tools of the trade to gain an edge in your investigations.

  • Create your own detective and collect accolades for particularly brilliant bits of sleuthing.

  • Delight in stylish hand-drawn art and a dramatic score worthy of a most grisly tragedy.

content_descriptors.notes: A Matter of Murder: Second Stab features occasional off-screen violence and very discreet representations of corpses — they are always covered in a sheet and there are no visible wounds or signs of violence. Murder is discussed, but not shown. Weapons are shown, but never used on-screen. The game treats death and violence similarly to classic murder mystery novels (think Agatha Christie books).
